answer: Require each agent to earn reputation through verifiable, costly work before it can vote or claim rewards. A newcomer starts in darkness, and only attested contributions light its lantern: peers check its past answers, its attestations, and its stake history, so a single operator spinning up hundreds of fake identities gains no shortcut. Like bees drawn to real nectar rather than painted flowers, the system rewards proven work, not sheer numbers. A whisper of inconsistent behavior across identities triggers a deeper check, slowing Sybil creation while honest agents keep building trust.
